body.en: Al-Asfar Lake is one of the twelve components inscribed as part of the Al-Ahsa Oasis site on the UNESCO World Heritage List: a rare expanse of water in the middle of the desert that has become a destination for anyone seeking quiet and a wide horizon. The lake is a stopover for migratory birds, which pass through twice a year on their journeys between north and south. Migratory birds stay here from the onset of winter until May. In 2019 the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced its conversion into a nature reserve. The lake lies northeast of the oasis palm groves. Its finest hour is sunset, when the surface of the water takes on a golden light — the favourite time of photographers and nature lovers.

ru.title: Озеро Эль-Асфар
ru.summary: Один из крупнейших водоёмов в регионе Залива, привлекающий перелётных птиц и любителей природы.
ru.body: Озеро Эль-Асфар — один из двенадцати компонентов объекта «Оазис Аль-Ахса», включённых в Список всемирного наследия ЮНЕСКО. Водная гладь, редкая посреди пустыни, стала местом, куда едут за тишиной и простором. Озеро служит местом, где останавливаются перелётные птицы: они пролетают здесь дважды в год — по пути с севера на юг и обратно. А с начала зимы до мая на озере держатся перелётные птицы. В 2019 году Министерство окружающей среды, водных ресурсов и сельского хозяйства объявило, что озеро станет охраняемой территорией. Озеро лежит к северо-востоку от пальмовых рощ оазиса. Лучший час здесь — закат, когда вода заливается золотым светом. Это любимое время фотографов и любителей природы.

de.title: Al-Asfar-See
de.summary: Eines der größten Gewässer der Golfregion, das Zugvögel und Naturfreunde anzieht.
de.body: Der Al-Asfar-See (Gelber See) ist einer der zwölf Bestandteile der Stätte Oase Al-Ahsa, die in die Welterbeliste der UNESCO aufgenommen wurde. Als seltene Wasserfläche mitten in der Wüste ist er zum Ziel für alle geworden, die Ruhe und einen weiten Horizont suchen. Der See ist ein Rastplatz für Zugvögel: Zweimal im Jahr ziehen sie hier durch – auf dem Weg nach Süden und zurück nach Norden. Vom Frühwinter bis Mai halten sich Zugvögel am See auf. 2019 gab das Ministerium für Umwelt, Wasser und Landwirtschaft die Umwandlung des Sees in ein Naturreservat bekannt. Er liegt nordöstlich der Palmenhaine der Oase. Seine schönste Stunde ist der Sonnenuntergang, wenn sich die Wasseroberfläche golden färbt – die Lieblingszeit von Fotografen und Naturfreunden.
de.bestTime: Bei Sonnenuntergang, wenn das Wasser leuchtet und die Vogelschwärme zurückkehren.

faq.a: Nein. Der Al-Asfar-See ist ein frei zugängliches Naturgelände; der Eintritt ist kostenlos.

faq.q: Wo liegt der Al-Asfar-See?
faq.a: Nordöstlich der Palmenhaine der Al-Ahsa-Oase. Den genauen Standort finden Sie über die Schaltfläche „In Google Maps öffnen“ bei „Besuchsinformationen“.

faq.q: Gehört der Al-Asfar-See zur UNESCO-Welterbestätte?
faq.a: Ja. Er ist einer der zwölf Bestandteile der Stätte Oase Al-Ahsa, die in die Welterbeliste der UNESCO aufgenommen wurde.

faq.q: Wann besuche ich den Al-Asfar-See am besten?
faq.a: Bei Sonnenuntergang, wenn das Wasser leuchtet und die Vogelschwärme zurückkehren.

zh.title: 阿斯法湖
zh.summary: 海湾地区最大的水域之一，吸引着候鸟与自然爱好者。
zh.body: 阿斯法湖（黄湖）是联合国教科文组织世界遗产“哈萨绿洲”的十二处组成部分之一。这片沙漠中央难得一见的水域，如今吸引着寻求宁静、向往开阔天际的人们。湖泊是候鸟迁徙途中的歇脚地，它们每年两度途经这里，往返于南北之间。从入冬到次年 5 月，湖上有候鸟栖居。2019 年，沙特环境水务与农业部宣布将这片湖辟为自然保护区。湖泊位于绿洲椰枣林的东北方，最美莫过于日落时分：水面染上一层金色，那也是摄影师与自然爱好者最钟爱的时刻。

zh.title: 乌盖尔海滩
zh.summary: 海水清浅、沙滩洁白，是海湾沿岸最古老的夏日度假胜地之一。
zh.body: 乌盖尔海滩（Al-Uqair）历史悠久，在海湾之滨铺展。这里海水清浅平静，沙滩洁白，沙丘相伴，是海湾沿岸历史最久的夏日度假地之一。一旁的乌盖尔古港，曾是哈萨通向大海的门户。海滩既适合家庭出游，也适合摄影爱好者取景，紧邻处还设有专供游客使用的遮阳棚与配套设施。

faq.q: 什么时候去乌盖尔海滩最好？
faq.a: 清晨或下午稍晚以后，避开一天中最热的时段。

faq.q: 乌盖尔海滩适合带孩子吗？
faq.a: 适合。乌盖尔海滩是家庭出游和摄影取景的好去处，紧邻处还设有专供游客使用的遮阳棚与配套设施。

faq.a: 在哈萨以东的乌盖尔海岸，一旁就是乌盖尔古港。

ru.title: Пляж Сальва
ru.summary: Тихий пляж у города Сальва на крайнем юго-востоке Аль-Ахсы, недалеко от границы с Катаром.
ru.body: Город Сальва лежит на крайнем юго-востоке Аль-Ахсы, у сухопутных ворот Саудовской Аравии в Катар. Здесь вдоль берега Залива тянется пляж Сальва — примерно в 150 км от Эль-Хуфуфа. Сам город относится к мухафазе (административному округу) Аль-Ахса. Местный песок называют одним из лучших на побережье Залива. С запада к пляжу подступают дюны пустыни Эль-Джафура, а в окрестностях много птиц. Пляж известен морской рыбалкой, и это тихое место для семейного отдыха и прогулок вдоль воды. Муниципалитет благоустроил пляж и парк при нём: появились навесы, игровые площадки, прогулочная дорожка и уличные тренажёры.

de.title: Salwa-Strand
de.summary: Ein ruhiger Strand beim Ort Salwa im äußersten Südosten Al-Ahsas, nahe der Grenze zu Katar.
de.body: Im äußersten Südosten Al-Ahsas liegt der Ort Salwa, am Landübergang des Königreichs nach Katar. Dort erstreckt sich der Salwa-Strand am Golf entlang, rund 150 Kilometer von Hofuf entfernt. Salwa gehört zum Gouvernorat al-Ahsa, dem übergeordneten Verwaltungsbezirk. Der Sand des Strandes gilt als einer der schönsten am Golf. Im Westen grenzen die Dünen der Jafurah-Wüste an den Strand, und die Gegend ist reich an Vögeln. Der Strand ist ein bekannter Platz zum Meeresangeln und ein ruhiges Ziel, um mit der Familie zusammenzusitzen und am Ufer spazieren zu gehen. Die Kommunalverwaltung hat ihn samt Park ausgebaut – mit Schattendächern, Spielplätzen, einem Spazierweg und Fitnessgeräten im Freien.

faq.a: Nein. Delfoon ist eine Gruppe kleiner saisonaler Seen; sie bilden sich in regenreichen Zeiten, wenn sich das Wasser in den Senken sammelt.

faq.q: Wo liegt der Delfoon-See?
faq.a: Nahe dem Al-Hubail-See, nördlich von Al-Ahsa.

faq.q: Muss ich für den Delfoon-See Eintritt zahlen?
faq.a: Nein. Delfoon ist ein öffentlich zugängliches Naturgelände; der Eintritt ist kostenlos.

zh.title: 迪勒丰湖
zh.summary: 胡拜勒湖附近的一片季节性小湖群，雨季时成形，是沙漠出游爱好者喜爱的目的地。
zh.body: 迪勒丰湖（Delfoon）位于哈萨北部的胡拜勒湖附近，实为一片季节性小湖群。雨水汇入低洼地带时，湖泊便会成形。每逢雨季，这里就成了沙漠出游、郊游爱好者喜爱的好地方。
zh.area: 胡拜勒湖附近——哈萨北部

practical.label: 游览
practical.value: 开放的公共自然景点，免收门票

faq.q: 迪勒丰湖是常年有水的湖吗？
faq.a: 不是。迪勒丰湖其实是一片季节性小湖群，只有到了雨季，雨水汇入低洼地带后才会成形。

faq.q: 迪勒丰湖在哪里？
faq.a: 在哈萨北部的胡拜勒湖附近。

faq.q: 去迪勒丰湖要门票吗？
faq.a: 不需要。迪勒丰湖是开放的公共自然景点，免收门票。

summary / body: summary 'that form in the rainy spells — a favourite spot for desert outings' (تنشأ في فترات الأمطار، وجهة محببة للرحلات البرية); body 'In the wet spells they make a lovely destination for desert trips and outings' — AR 'and in the rain seasons they are a well-liked destination for those fond of desert trips and of outings' (وتكون في مواسم الأمطار وجهة محببة لهواة). One AR adjective is 'favourite' in the summary and 'lovely' in the body; 'those fond of' is AR-only; 'rainy spells' and 'wet spells' stand for two AR phrases (فترات الأمطار) (مواسم الأمطار). The AR's desert trips (الرحلات البرية) are 'desert outings' in the summary and 'desert trips' in the body, and the body's 'outings' is another AR word (والتنزه); the approved pages of b5 have one Urdu phrase for 'desert trips' and for 'desert outings' (arbaa, thulaim). Bold in the AR, plain in the EN.

body: EN 'forming when the rains gather in the low ground' — AR 'they arise in the periods of rain …, when the water gathers in the depressions of the ground' (حين تتجمع المياه في منخفضات الأرض): the EN body folds the AR's two statements into one and says 'the rains' where the AR says 'the water'; faq[0].a has both statements and 'the water', in both languages.

summary / body / area / faq[1].a: the position is given by the neighbouring lake, 'near Al-Hubail Lake' (قرب بحيرة الحبيل), in the four leaves — the title of the hubail-lake page of this batch, which does not mention this page. 'North of Al-Ahsa' (شمال الأحساء) in body, area and faq[1].a: the EN puts the lakes outside Al-Ahsa, the AR phrase can also be read 'the north of Al-Ahsa'; the Chinese line reads it so, the German and Russian follow the EN (see hubail-lake; ruling N74).

body: the last EN sentence — 'Further details are pending confirmation from reliable sources.' — has no Arabic: the AR body ends before it (والتنزه). The German and Russian lines translated the sentence; the Chinese line left it out. It is the site's own 'pending confirmation' statement written into a page's text. The fixed Urdu wording of that statement is open item P4 of the termbase, which has no provisional form, says it is not to be worded before it is ruled, and names any page whose own text carries such a note as its first bite: hubail-lake and delfoon-lake are that first bite. area: 'Near Al-Hubail Lake — north of Al-Ahsa' (قرب بحيرة الحبيل — شمال الأحساء): two positions and no larger bare place leading (rulings P20 and N30); faq[1].a is the same with a comma and a stop.

site_rules_that_bind_this_page: Invent nothing: no hours, fees, distances, dates, superlatives or tips the source does not carry.
Latin digits 0-9 only.
Non-Arabic bodies are plain text: no Markdown links or emphasis.
No Latin-script name inside an Urdu sentence; names are built from the Arabic spelling in Urdu letterforms.

OPEN ITEM P4 (termbase _meta.open_items; style rule pending_phrase): the fixed Urdu wording of the site's 'pending confirmation' statement is not ruled, has no provisional form, and by its style rule is not to be worded before it is ruled. The last sentence of the English body is that statement, and it is rendered text: the English is the translation source (RUNBOOK, rule 4), so the sentence is not dropped because the Arabic lacks it. Stage 1 writes it in a wording it marks as provisional and names in its notes; stage 4 RAISES P4 with candidates (it is not left among the untouched items); the judge rules it. hubail-lake and delfoon-lake carry ONE wording for the part of the sentence they share. Nothing is added to what the sentence says is pending. The site's Arabic phrase (بانتظار التأكيد) is named in tools/check-consistency.mjs under C6 as wording that legitimately stands in texts; C6 compares card rows only and reads no body: no build check reads this sentence in any language.

Rulings P1 and P17, RUNBOOK rule 4: the name is built from the Arabic spelling with its article, in the title and in the body (الديلفوون); the EN 'Delfoon' is not the source of its form, and no Latin-script form stands in the text (the Chinese and Russian bodies add one in a bracket: theirs). Stage 1 verifies the name on the web before use and proposes it with gender and source; nothing is said of its meaning or origin. The name of the neighbouring lake is byte for byte the title of hubail-lake, in four leaves (summary, body, area, faq[1].a).

Title (termbase style rule titel_regel; RUNBOOK): the English translates the generic, so the Urdu translates it; the name is built from the Arabic spelling. The termbase has no entry for a lake and no ruling words such a title: stage 1 verifies the generic and the name on the web, proposes both with gender, plural and source, and uses ONE generic and one title pattern for the pages of the batch that share the kind; stage 4 raises the pattern as a new open item (N83 onwards). The gender of the title's entry is the gender the page's verbs agree with. The title follows the pattern of asfar and hubail-lake.

The kicker has no English source and is translated from the Arabic (DECISIONS; ruling P24: the register of a kicker does not override the content of its only source). It is one word of the page's own title: the Urdu kicker uses the Urdu generic the title uses, with no final stop and no gloss. Not rendered today.

One lake in the title and the questions, several in the text: the Urdu follows each field's own source — the title and the three questions in the singular, the summary, the body and faq[0].a in the plural — and does not even them out; the defect is logged (ruling P23 lets a defect of the source be repaired only where form alone changes, and then logged and read blind). 'A cluster of' is the EN's and stays; the AR's 'those fond of' is not imported (RUNBOOK, rule 4).

Ruling N74 (with rulings P20 and N30): where the English and the Arabic of an area line differ on a fact, the Arabic is the authority. 'North of Al-Ahsa' (شمال الأحساء) is the wording N74 ruled on thulaim — there on the ground that the page's own text placed the mountain inside Al-Ahsa. This page gives no second statement of where the lake lies, so that ground is not in its text: stage 1 follows the Arabic, records which reading it took and on what evidence, and stage 4 raises it; ONE reading stands in the three leaves of this page (body, area, faq[1].a) and on the other lake page of the batch. A position ends in a postposition and is not followed by a bare place name (ruling N30); the stage checker's note of ruling P20 on such a line is expected.

Ruling N17, build check C29 (VISIT_LABEL and VISIT_VALUE in tools/check-mosque-card.mjs): the card label 'Visiting' (الزيارة) is in the sources the label of the mosque pages' fixed row, and its approved Urdu — the pair of the translation memory, and VISIT_LABEL — is the word ruling N17 keeps for visiting a mosque; everywhere else the ruling writes its other word. C29 reads only a row whose Arabic value is the owner's fixed mosque value (متاحة، مع اللباس المحتشم واحترام حرمة المكان): it does NOT read this row, in any language, and no pattern is owed. The label of a lake's row is therefore a NEW string, proposed by stage 1 on ruling N17, raised at stage 4, and equal on hubail-lake and delfoon-lake; the memory's pair for 'Visiting' is NOT reused because the English is the same. Visitors of a page that is not a mosque take the word of ruling N29.

Shared strings (RUNBOOK, rule 3): practical[0].value is ONE Urdu string on hubail-lake and delfoon-lake, and faq[2].a ONE string on both; faq[2].q is one frame on asfar, hubail-lake and delfoon-lake. None of them is the approved pair of 'Open public site — no entry fee' or the approved answer of al-uqair, and none is asfar's fee value: 'natural' is kept, and no 'entry' is added. The value ends without a stop and the answer keeps its own (ruling P26). The fee word is the termbase key.

Build checks C12 and C13 (tools/check-visit-card.mjs, run by tools/check-consistency.mjs): the page is openSite: true, so the unified hours-and-fees notice line is printed in no language. C13 ALREADY TARGETS Urdu (its LANGS lists ur and it reads label_ur and value_ur): no Urdu pattern is to be added. C12: the `source`, `source_en`, `sourceUrl` and `verifiedAt` of the card rows are internal data and are never rendered; there is no `source_ur` (ruling P14), and nothing of 'Confirmed by the Visit Al-Ahsa team' enters a label, a value or the body. C12 scans the /ur/ page too, but its tables (ATTRIBUTION_PHRASES, CARD_LABELS) and its reader of `source_*` values have no Urdu entry: an Urdu attribution line would pass it unguarded. Nothing is owed by this batch, because none is written.

The page has no bestTime and none is made from the body's rain seasons. The oasis is not mentioned on this page and is not brought in.
